set.name: Pacer
set.mechanism: The pacer at a race wears a bib and runs a steady time so others hit theirs: the mark is that bib, the type is a calm printed start number, and the palette is trail brown on bib white with Okanagan lake blue for the pace you are holding.
set.expression_move: The bib, and nothing else loud: plain captions, steady type, one small blue.
set.differs_by: The reference creators sell intensity; a pacer is the opposite, steady and a few steps ahead, so Shay's content reads as 'run with me' rather than 'watch me'.

logo.concept: A pacer's bib with four pin holes and the name punched through: steady, a few steps ahead, there to run with.

rationale.claim: Shay picked the bib as the most distinctive idea of round one and wants to help people; a pacer is the runner whose job is other people's finish.
Lake blue against trail brown differs in lightness as well as hue, so it survives colour-blind viewing better than round one's pine.
Warm with a light cool accent is a well-rated pairing direction.

palette.name: Pacer
palette.direction: Trail brown on bib white, Okanagan lake blue for the pace line.

brand.name: Okanagan Lake
brand.usage: pace lines, tags, one highlight per screen; on brown or as fills, never as text on white

set.name: Spotter
set.mechanism: A spotter's hands around the bar, ready but not lifting for you: two square brackets grip a bar, which is also how code holds a value, so the mark, the mono-plus-sans type and the walnut-and-steel palette all say 'I've got you, you do the rep'.
set.expression_move: The bracketed bar; type and colour stay plain.
set.differs_by: None of the reference creators uses a symbol; this one carries builder and gym in one shape and stays readable at avatar size.

logo.concept: Two brackets grip a bar: a spotter's hands, and code holding a value.

rationale.claim: Brackets are code to a CS student and hands to anyone in a gym; one shape covers both halves of Shay's life.
Plex Mono and Plex Sans share one skeleton, so the code voice and the reading voice match without effort.

palette.name: Spotter
palette.direction: Walnut hands on chalk white, a steel bar.

set.name: Trail Blaze
set.mechanism: Painted blazes on trees mark the path for whoever comes next: two offset larch-gold blazes (the trail sign for 'turn here') sit beside a relaxed lowercase name on bark brown.
set.expression_move: The two blazes in larch gold; everything else is bark and birch.
set.differs_by: Outdoorsy and slow where the reference feeds are studio or gym; it makes Shay the person who marks the way, not the one performing.

logo.concept: Two offset trail blazes, the sign for 'turn here', painted for whoever is behind you.

defaults_used.why: Larches in the Okanagan turn gold in fall, the one place-specific fall colour Shay has lived with; used only for the blazes, with no cream or terracotta beside it.

rationale.claim: A double blaze is a real trail sign meaning a turn ahead; the mark keeps that meaning without explaining it.
Larch gold reads only on dark grounds, so the card and avatar sit on bark brown.

palette.name: Trail Blaze
palette.direction: Bark brown and birch white, larch gold for the blazes.

brand.name: Larch Gold
brand.usage: the blazes, one highlight per screen
